name: cache-statusband
description: Nate Herk's Cache Keeper plus a ccstatusline-style status band: model, effort, context, cache, 5-hour/weekly/Fable usage with resets, and reopened chats measured before you send

author.name: Hameishiv, built on Cache Keeper by Nate Herk

seatFileTerminal.title: Seat file (terminal)
seatFileTerminal.description: For account rotators: a file holding the active seat's label (e.g. ~/.claude-cli-accounts/.active). Read when a session starts: the band shows that label in place of the account email. A running session keeps its account, so a change counts only once the rotator's wake-up prompt (below) reaches it, or within 3 minutes after it. Leave empty to show the account email.

seatFileDesktop.title: Seat file (desktop app)
seatFileDesktop.description: The same for sessions the desktop app runs, so each seat keeps its own usage reading. The app's band doesn't show it. Leave empty to turn off.

rotatorWakePattern.title: Rotator wake-up pattern
rotatorWakePattern.description: A regular expression matching the prompt an unattended account rotator types after rotating. Such a prompt is compacted first without asking, since nobody is there to answer. For 3 minutes after it, a late rewrite of the seat file or the account is still taken as that rotation. Leave empty to turn off.

prPattern.title: PR session pattern
prPattern.description: A regular expression whose first group is a PR number, matched against a session's first prompt (e.g. (?:^|\s)/?merge-pr\s+#?(\d+)). Keep warm then stops once gh reports that PR merged or closed. Leave empty to turn off.

autoResume.title: Auto-resume after usage renews
autoResume.description: When a chat's turn is cut short because the plan's usage ran out, send it "Resume" a minute after the full window resets. Spends usage without asking, so it is off by default. A big chat is compacted first. With no known reset time it tries hourly, three times at most. A resume armed from a full window is tried a minute after the account changes instead of at that window's reset, since the window was the old account's, and a failure from a request still out when the account changes is retried a minute later without counting as a try. The request a message you send starts settles it; /clear and resuming another chat cancel it. While the Resume compacts, a message that reaches the chat (another plugin's too), /clear or resuming another chat cancels it; a local command (not /plan with a description, which goes to the model unless the chat is already in plan mode, where it only shows the plan: a mod is not told the mode), or a message another hook drops does not. A rotator wake-up arriving cancels it too, and waits for the compaction already running, using it if it succeeds. A cold-send dialog open for a message of yours holds it until it closes: Cancel lets it go, Send anyway or Compact first cancels it (a /btw question does not: it never reaches the chat). With no request starting within 2 minutes, a cancelled Resume is armed again then (the band shows it meanwhile), and if its compaction succeeded it goes without compacting again. If its compaction failed and you answered Cancel on a cold-send dialog while it compacted, it is armed again the same way rather than sent uncompacted; if that compaction fails too, it is not sent and a toast says to send Resume yourself. A compaction still running after 15 minutes is abandoned, but it may still finish: until it does, no send starts another. The Resume is not sent uncompacted and is tried again 2 minutes later without compacting, as a counted try (if compaction was the cause, the last toast says it did not finish). A message or wake-up that started it or waited on it goes back in the prompt box (several together, in the order sent, as one text), and a pending Resume then waits at least 2 minutes more. If it finishes later and succeeded, later sends go without compacting again. A Resume that cannot be sent, directly or after compacting, is tried again 2 minutes later, four attempts in all, unless a request or /clear settles it meanwhile. A due resume waits while the cold-send dialog is open, any send handed on that is not this mod's own is being handed on, compacting or has not yet started its request (at most 2 minutes), or a rotator wake-up's request has not started.
